dogecoin.text: I think once the #crypto community gets people to understand that #dogecoin ain’t it, and that there’s better projects out there, then the real parabolic run will kick in lol.
What I’m also trying to say here is that... when are these people actually going to realize that there are much better #cryptocurrency out there that will outlast #dogecoin?

It's crazy cause people back then wouldn't dare touch #dogecoin or similar kinds of assets...

Now ppl are all about it! Like people know these stocks & coins are memes but they still want to get in on it. GameStop & WSB really made a movement that led to this #doge hype.

Is it mean to be happy that these meme coin chasers got rekt badly experiencing their first big dump or nah? Hopefully they learned their lesson and look for quality over memes now.
